desc:
😎 Welcome to +1 Clean Keyboard Adventure!

How to Play:  
🧼 Run across giant keyboards and clean the keys  
⚡ Clean keys and train your Speed to run faster  
🏆 Complete stages and collect Wins  
💪 Upgrade your Cleaning Range to clean more keys at once  
🔥 Rebirth to grow stronger and go even further  

Having fun? Don’t forget to like the game! 👍
